name: Ombre Body Mist- I found You (W) -120ml
description:
"Unfold the pages of destiny, a fruity floral fragrance blend of peach, cherry blossom, and red apple followed by a soft bouquet of Lilac and Jasmine. Spray the mist directly on your skin focusing on the nerve points like wrists and neck.
 
Top Note: Peach, Cherry Blossom and Red Apple
Middle Note: Lilac and Jasmine
Last Note: Musk, Tamarind and White Woods

All-day protection against sweat odor
Long-lasting fragrance
Quick absorption, non-greasy
Inspired by Love Spell from Victoria's Secret
 
Caution:
Do not expose to temperature exceeding 50°C. Avoid direct contact with eyes and broken skin. In case of any irritation, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children."
